result_semantics: phase-2 new exploratory measured-data calculation; not approved manuscript replacement

likelihood.observations: raw unrebinned integer detector counts per channel
likelihood.line_shape: unit-normalized Gaussian plus unit-normalized left-exGaussian charge-loss mixture, integrated over calibrated bin edges
likelihood.resolution: declared per-table form; Table 3 canonical sigma_keV = sqrt(intercept_keV^2 + variance_slope_keV * nominal_line_energy_keV)
likelihood.background: declared interval-nonnegative Bernstein affine or quadratic counts/s/keV density evaluated at calibrated bin centers, with a free common background-scale nuisance for each run after the first; quadratic endpoint coefficients are nonnegative while the middle coefficient may be negative subject to the exact cone middle + sqrt(low*high) >= 0
likelihood.multi_run_signal: Table 3 canonical phase-2 fit has one nonnegative detected full-peak rate for every run and component; the former shared origin-class scaling model is retained only as a restrictive comparison
likelihood.calibration: common offset and fractional-gain-stretch nuisances with declared Gaussian constraints; Table 3 additionally declares zero-centered per-run offset/stretch deviations and relative resolution-scale nuisances for runs after the reference run
likelihood.optimization: stable per-bin Poisson NLL relative to saturation; scaled L-BFGS-B warm solve with deterministic box-constrained SLSQP polish when required; quadratic backgrounds use a relaxed middle coefficient followed by an exact interval-nonnegative cone postcheck and transformed constrained fallback on violation; success requires the declared scaled projected-gradient stationarity gate
likelihood.canonical_intervals: Full Fisher covariance for regular interior fits; 95% profile likelihood where implemented for weak/boundary ratios, using tight stable-difference SLSQP, exact quadratic-cone coordinates, explicit inner-solver/KKT gates, and a frozen fitted-NLL versus tight-profile-base consistency check; deterministic parametric bootstrap remains a coverage diagnostic; model-variant RMS covariance is kept separate
likelihood.fisher_covariance: Expected Fisher rank, condition, and inversion are evaluated in declared scaled-parameter coordinates; the inverse is transformed back to physical coordinates before extracting yield covariance
likelihood.information_criteria: Any AIC/BIC-shaped arithmetic is labeled nonstandard penalized-objective descriptive arithmetic because the objective includes Gaussian constraint penalties; it is not used for model promotion
likelihood.coverage_diagnostic: deterministic joint parametric bootstrap of raw-bin Poisson counts and every Gaussian constraint pseudo-observation; each Gaussian pseudo-observation is independently drawn from N(fitted generating nuisances, declared covariance) and used as the constraint center for that replica; diagnostic only

selection.reason: Only public reactor-on low-gain RD family matching the no-added-water/no-added-floor-lead shield description; public catalog contains no Cycle 498 run.

temporal_model_policy.consequence: power-correlated and activation/decay models are reported non-identifiable rather than supplied invented covariates

table3.simultaneous_fit_reason: All four files share the exact database calibration, detector, orientation, shield, and run family. Counts are not combined. The canonical phase-2 likelihood estimates every run/component yield independently while retaining shared calibration, resolution, line-shape, background-shape, and nuisance covariance.
table3.heterogeneity_boundary_policy: Rate GLS excludes a run when that component yield is on a fitted bound; ratio GLS excludes a run when either numerator or denominator yield is on a fitted bound. Excluded runs remain in per-run and exposure-summed descriptive products. A diagnostic is unavailable, not negative, when fewer than two interior runs remain.

origin_class_policy.assignment: explicit per component; no identity-string pattern matching
origin_class_policy.phase2_status: identity labels only; origin class imposes no equality or scale constraint in the canonical independent-run yield fit
origin_class_policy.phase1_comparison: The shared origin-class scale factorization is retained only as a restrictive likelihood comparison and does not define the corrected estimand

calibration_constraint.warning: The release gives A0/A1 but no calibration covariance or run-to-run drift covariance. The common constraint and zero-centered per-run deviation constraints (sigma 0.25 keV offset and 1e-4 fractional stretch) are declared applicability assumptions, not released metrology. Spectrum index 0 is the reference; later-run deviations are relative to it.

resolution_initial.per_run_scale_warning: The release supplies no run-specific resolution uncertainty. Relative scales for spectra after index 0 have independent Gaussian constraints centered at 1 with sigma 0.12; this is a declared sensitivity assumption.

table8.simulation_policy: Measured-data candidates only. Missing monoenergetic simulations are neither fabricated nor summed; each future simulation must be fit separately with a declared case identity.
table8.contaminant_policy: Phase 2 tests only catalogued lines from materials documented or physically plausible in the detector assembly. Canonical Fe-54 and Cu-63 additions have source plausibility and residual support. The close Al-27/Ge-70 6.71-MeV alternatives directly reallocate a target DEP and are retained at equal noncanonical sensitivity status despite their likelihood difference. Residual-only automatic peak discovery is prohibited.
